questions.scenario: At the park, Peter and Ben are talking about sports.
questions.question:
Peter: Can you swim, Ben?
Ben: ___________________
options: Yes, I am. I can swim.
No, I don't. I can swim.
No, I can't. I can't swim.
Yes, you are. You can swim.
questions.explanation: 問句以 Can you...? 結尾，簡答時必須對應使用 can 或 can't，並且主詞要轉換為 I。選項 A 和 B 使用了錯誤的 Be 動詞或 do 助動詞，是常見的母語干擾迷思。
questions.commonMisconception: 被『Yes, I am.』的口語習慣干擾，忘記助動詞 Can 必須與 can / can't 對應。

questions.scenario: Emma is asking about Leo's talents for the school talent show.
questions.question:
Emma: Look at the piano. Can you play the piano?
Leo: ___________________
options: Yes, I can. I can play the piano.
Yes, I am. I can play the piano.
No, I don't. I can't play the piano.
No, you can't. You can play the piano.
questions.explanation: 問句是 Can you...?，正面回答需為 Yes, I can.。選項 B 誤用了 Be 動詞 am，選項 C 誤用了助動詞 don't，選項 D 的人稱代名詞 you 沒有轉換為 I。
questions.commonMisconception: 在簡答中誤將 can 替換為 am 或 don't。

questions.scenario: Two friends are watching a bird in the sky.
questions.question:
Anna: The bird is fast. Can it fly?
Sam: ___________________
options: Yes, it is. It can fly up high.
Yes, it can. It can fly up high.
No, it doesn't. It can fly up high.
No, it isn't. It can't fly up high.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 it (the bird)，助動詞為 can，所以肯定回答必須是 Yes, it can.，其餘選項誤用了 is 或是 doesn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Be 動詞 (is) 與助動詞 (can) 混用。

questions.scenario: During P.E. class, the teacher is asking the students about their skills.
questions.question:
Teacher: Can you and Tim jump rope?
Student: ___________________
options: Yes, we can. We can jump rope well.
Yes, they are. They can jump rope well.
No, we aren't. We can't jump rope well.
No, you don't. You can't jump rope well.
questions.explanation: 問句中的主詞是 you and Tim (你和Tim)，這等同於第二人稱複數 (你們)。因此回答時必須切換為第一人稱複數 we (我們)，並且搭配助動詞 can。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略了『you and Tim』是複數『你們』，導致回答用了錯誤的代名詞如 they 或 you，且容易誤用 aren't/don't。

questions.scenario: Amy's dog is running super fast in the yard.
questions.question:
Jack: Your dog is very cute. Can he catch a ball?
Amy: ___________________
options: Yes, he is. He can catch a ball.
Yes, he does. He can catch a ball.
No, he can't. He can't catch a ball.
No, it doesn't. It can catch a ball.
questions.explanation: 問句主詞是 he (指公狗)，且由 Can 提問。選項 A 誤用 is，選項 B 誤用 does。選項 C 是正確的否定簡答 No, he can't.，選項 D 不僅前後文意矛盾 (No 搭配 can)，也誤用了 doesn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 未對齊問答中的助動詞 Can，或者在否定簡答時出現前後矛盾的語法邏輯。

questions.scenario: The children are talking about their grandfather's secret talent.
questions.question:
Lily: My grandpa is eighty years old.
Tom: Wow! ___________________
Lily: No, he can't.
options: Is he a good dancer?
Can he dance very well?
Does he dance very well?
Are you a good dancer?
questions.explanation: 根據 Lily 的回答 No, he can't. 可以逆推 Tom 的問句必定是以 Can 開頭，並且主詞為 he。只有 Can he dance very well? 完全符合此邏輯對應。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能只看中文『他會跳舞嗎？』而去選擇 Does he 或是 Is he，忽略了回答中的 can't 提示。

questions.scenario: A brother and sister are playing by the swimming pool.
questions.question:
Brother: Let's run by the pool!
Sister: No! You ___________________
options: can't run by the clear pool.
aren't run by the clear pool.
doesn't run by the clear pool.
isn't run by the clear pool.
questions.explanation: 表達『不能、不可以』的能力或准許狀態時，應使用 can't。選項 B、D 使用 Be 動詞搭配原形動詞屬於嚴重文法錯誤，選項 C doesn't 不能接在 You 之後。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Be 動詞否定 (aren't) 與一般動詞 (run) 直接堆疊在一起。

questions.scenario: Kevin wants to join the school's music club and is talking to the teacher.
questions.question:
Teacher: Welcome to the music club. ___________________
Kevin: Yes, I can. I can sing well.
options: Are you singing very well?
Do you sing very well here?
Can you sing very well here?
Is he singing very well?
questions.explanation: 從 Kevin 回答 Yes, I can. 可以明確知道老師的問句必須使用助動詞 Can 提問。選項 A、B 雖然語意相近，但文法對應會導致回答變為 Yes, I am 或 Yes, I do。
questions.commonMisconception: 未察覺上下文的助動詞連貫性，盲目選擇看起來意思合理的 Are you 或 Do you。

questions.scenario: Sally is drawing a picture of a cute monkey on the whiteboard.
questions.question:
Mark: It's a nice monkey. Can it climb trees?
Sally: ___________________
options: Yes, it is. It can climb trees.
Yes, it can. It can climb trees.
No, it doesn't. it climb trees.
No, it isn't. It can't climb trees.
questions.explanation: 問句主詞 it，助動詞 Can，肯定回答為 Yes, it can.。其餘選項皆混淆了 Be 動詞 (is) 或助動詞 (does)。選項 C 甚至有大小寫錯誤且語意矛盾。
questions.commonMisconception: 對於助動詞 Can 提問，習慣性回答 it is 或 it doesn't。

questions.scenario: The mother is asking her daughter about her new friends from school.
questions.question:
Mother: Can your friends ride a bike?
Daughter: ___________________
options: Yes, they are. They can ride a bike.
Yes, we do. We can ride a bike.
No, they can't. They can't ride a bike.
No, they aren't. They can't ride a bike.
questions.explanation: your friends 是複數第三人稱，代名詞為 they。由 Can 提問，否定回答必須是 No, they can't.。選項 A、D 誤用 Be 動詞，選項 B 人稱代名詞錯用為 we 且助動詞為 do。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 your friends 誤認為包含自己在內的 we，或是回答時錯用 Be 動詞 aren't。
